title: Protocol to analyze lipid asymmetry in the plasma membrane
protocol: Count cells using a hemocytometer or cell counter with trypan blue staining.
Transfer 1–2 × 10^6 of viable cells to a 1.5- or 2-mL tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g at 20°C–25°C for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 1 mL of phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Resuspend the cells and centrifuge at 300 × g at 20°C–25°C for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend the cells in 300 μL of HBSS containing 2 mM CaCl2 and 1 mM MgCl2.
Stand the tube in a dry block incubator set at 15 or 20°C for 7 minutes.
Add 2 μL of 1 mM NBD-PS or NBD-PE to 1 mL of HBSS with 2 mM CaCl2 and 1 mM MgCl2 (final concentration of 2 μM).
Immediately add 300 μL of HBSS containing NBD-lipids to the cell suspension (final concentration of 1 μM).
Incubate cells at 15 or 20°C in the dry block incubator.
Incubate cells with NBD-lipids within 40 minutes.
Pipette cell suspension every 5-10 minutes during the assay.
Mix cell suspension by pipetting at several time points.
Transfer 100- to 150-μL aliquots quickly to a 1.5-mL tube containing pre-chilled HBSS with 5 mg/mL fatty acid-free BSA on ice.
Resuspend cells quickly and incubate on ice for 1 minute.
Incubate cells with 5 mg/mL fatty acid-free BSA on ice for 1 minute.
Transfer 300 μL of the cell suspension to a 5-mL round-bottomed test tube with a cell strainer snap cap.
Analyze cells immediately with FACSCanto II or FACSAria III (BD).
Gate cells by standard forward and side scatter (FSC/SSC) to exclude dead cells from the population.
Count cells using a hemocytometer or cell counter (TC20, Bio-Rad) with trypan blue staining.
Transfer 1 × 10^6 of viable cells to a 1.5- or 2-mL tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g at 20°C–25°C for 3 min.
Aspirate the supernatant and add 1 ml of Annexin staining buffer (10 mM HEPES-KOH, pH=7.4, 140 mM NaCl, and 2.5 mM CaCl2).
Resuspend cells.
Centrifuge at 300 × g at 20°C–25°C for 3 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of Annexin staining buffer containing 1,000-fold diluted Annexin V-Cy5 and 5 μg/mL PI.
Incubate at 20°C for 3 minutes in a dry block incubator.
Transfer 500 μL of the cell suspension to a 5-mL round-bottomed test tube with a cell strainer snap cap.
Stimulate cells with calcium ionophore A23187 at a final concentration of 1–3 μM.
Incubate cells at 25 or 30°C for 5 min to induce PtdSer exposure.
Generate truncated Lysenin tagged with RFP for binding SM-rich membrane domains without pore formation or cell toxicity.
Fuse D4 of Perfringolysin O with mCherry to generate mCherry-D4 for monitoring cholesterol in the outer leaflet of plasma membranes.
Employ a cold-shock expression system using pCold I DNA vector and cspA promoter for high-yield production of His-tagged NT-Lys-mRFP or mCherry-D4 in E. coli.
Express His-tagged NT-Lys-mRFP in E. coli.
Express His-tagged mCherry-D4 in E. coli.
Transform 50 μL of chaperone-competent cells pGro7/BL21 with 1–10 ng of pCold I-His6-mRFP-NT-Lys or pCold I-His6-mCherry-D4 in a 1.5-mL tube.
Stand the tube on ice for 10–15 min.
Stand the tube at 42°C for 45 s in a dry block incubator.
Stand the tube on ice for 1–2 min.
Add 1 mL LB medium without antibiotics to the tube.
Shake the tube at 180–200 rpm at 37°C for 60 min.
Plate ten- to one hundred-microliter aliquots onto an LB agar plate containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and 20 μg/mL chloramphenicol.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for 12–16 h.
Select a colony and transfer it to a 50-mL tube with 10 mL LB medium containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin and 20 μg/mL chloramphenicol.
Shake the tube at 180–200 rpm at 37°C for 12–16 h.
Transfer five-milliliter aliquots to a 1-L flask with 250 mL of LB medium containing 100 μg/mL ampicillin, 20 μg/mL chloramphenicol, and 0.8 mg/mL L-arabinose.
Grow cells under shaking at 180–200 rpm at 37°C for 3 h.
Measure optical density at 600 nm (OD600) every 30 min.
When OD600 reaches approximately 0.5, stand the flask in an incubator at 15°C for 30 min without shaking.
Add IPTG at a final concentration of 0.1 mM (for mRFP-NT-Lys) or 0.2 mM (for mCherry-D4).
Shake the flask at 180–200 rpm at 15°C for 24 h.
Collect cells and transfer them to a 250-mL tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 2,500 × g at 4°C for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant from the pellets.
Wash the pellets with PBS.
Centrifuge the tube at 2,500 × g at 4°C for 10 min.
Repeat steps of removing supernatant and washing pellets.
Remove the final supernatant.
Snap-freeze the bacteria pellet in liquid nitrogen.
Store the frozen pellet at -80°C.
Thaw the frozen pellet and stand it on ice.
Add 10 mL of buffer A supplemented with a protease inhibitor cocktail to the tube.
Suspend the bacterial pellets gently.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15-mL tube.
Stand the tube containing the suspension on ice.
Disrupt cells by sonication at an amplitude of 35% (3-s on and 15-s off) for 20-30 cycles.
Centrifuge the disrupted cell mixture at 12,000 × g at 4°C for 20 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new 50-mL tube.
Add 20 mL of buffer A supplemented with a protease inhibitor cocktail to the supernatant.
Add 1 mL of buffer A-equilibrated Ni-NTA Agarose to the mixture.
Rotate the tube at approximately 10 rpm at 4°C for 12–16 h.
Centrifuge the tube at 3,000 × g at 4°C for 10 min.
Remove the supernatant from agarose beads.
Suspend agarose in 5 mL of buffer A.
Load pre-chilled PBS into the column over 12–16 hours by adjusting the three-way stopcock (the total wash volume is approximately 2 L).
Elute bound proteins sequentially with elution buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl, pH=7.5, 150 mM NaCl) by increasing imidazole in a stepwise manner from 10 to 500 mM (10, 100, 200, 300, and 500 mM).
Mix eluates at appropriate fractions.
Load the mixed solution onto pre-equilibrated Amicon Ultra -15 Centrifugal Filters (10 K cut-off).
Centrifuge at 4,000 × g for 1–2 hours to concentrate the solutions.
Transfer concentrated eluates to a micro dialyzer (Xpress Micro Dialyzer MD300 12–14 kDa, Scienova).
Dialyze against 2 L of PBS at 4°C with stirring for 12–16 hours.
Change PBS to another 2 L and continue dialysis with stirring at 4°C.
Aliquot purified proteins after dialysis.
Snap-freeze aliquoted proteins in liquid nitrogen.
Store purified proteins at -80°C for at least one year.
Expand WR19L or their transformant cells in RPMI1640-10% FCS containing 100 U/mL penicillin and 100 μg/mL streptomycin in a 10-cm culture dish.
Transfer 2 × 10^5 cells to a 1.5-mL tube and centrifuge at 300 × g at 20°C–25°C for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant and add 1 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge at 300 × g at 20°C–25°C for 3 min.
Add 300 μL of pre-chilled HBSS containing 10 μg/mL NT-Lys-mRFP or mCherry-D4.
Resuspend cells and incubate on ice for 30 min.
Add SYTOX Blue at a final concentration of 100 nM.
Transfer 300 μL of the cell suspension to a 5-mL round-bottomed test tube with a cell strainer snap cap.
Stain Atp11a-Atp11c double-null (DKO) WR19L-derived cells and their transformants expressing wild-type human ATP11A or its mutants with 10 μg/mL NT-Lys-mRFP.
Stain the same cell types with 10 μg/mL mCherry-D4.
Observe representative histograms of non-stained (grey) and stained (purple) cells.
